entries.jp: 龍馬達の演奏以上の\n大歓声が会場を包んだ
entries.en:
A roar even
louder than
for Ryoma's
band engulfed
the venue.

entries.jp: もはや熱気は　会場が\n燃え上がりそうなほど\n高まっている
entries.en:
The heat had
risen so high it
seemed the whole
venue might
burst into flames.

entries.jp: ぎゃあああ！\nジュニア様ー！
entries.en: Kyaaaah!\nJunior-samaaa!

entries.jp: ああっ　ダメ……\n私　もう立ってられない
entries.en: Ahh, no... I\ncan't stand\nup anymore...

entries.jp: ジューニアー\nうおおお
entries.en: Juuuniooor!\nWooooo!

entries.jp: 坂本達もすげえけど\nやっぱ格が違うぜ……
entries.en:
Sakamoto and
his guys are
amazing too, but
he's on a whole
other level...

entries.jp: ハートで理解しただろう\nオレこそがロックスター
entries.en:
You understand
it in your heart
now. I am the
rock star.

entries.jp: イッツ\nロケンロゥーッ！
entries.en: It's rock 'n' rolllll!

entries.jp: オレ様達のは\nロックじゃねえって\n言いたいのかよ……
entries.en: So he's saying\nwhat we play\nisn't rock...?

entries.jp: ですが　晋作\nあの演奏の前では\nそう言われても……
entries.en:
But, Shinsaku...
after a
performance
like that, even
if he says so...

entries.jp: くっ……
entries.en: Tch...

entries.jp: いや……\n実際すごい演奏じゃ\n世界は広いぜよ！
entries.en:
No... That really
was an amazin'
performance.
The world sure
is a big place!

entries.jp: 感心してる場合か！\nこのままじゃ\n負けちまうぞ！
entries.en:
Is this the time
to be impressed!?
At this rate we're
gonna lose!

entries.jp: あっ　そうか\nいや　でも　ホントに\nすごかったぜよ！
entries.en: Oh, right. Still,\nthat really was\namazin'!

entries.jp: じゅにあ\n後でサインとか\nくれないかなぁ
entries.en:
Wonder if
Junior'd give me
an autograph
later...

entries.jp: 敵にサインもらって\nどうする！\nバカか　お前は！
entries.en:
What're you
gonna do with an
autograph from
the enemy!? Are
you an idiot!?

entries.jp: さすが龍馬くんは\n大物ですね……
entries.en: Ryoma-kun\ntruly is a man of\ngreat stature...

entries.jp: 次の曲　行こうか\nアーユーレディ？
entries.en: Let's go, next\nsong. Are\nyou ready?

entries.jp: ジュニアがマイクを\n持つだけで地が揺れるほど\n歓声が起きた
entries.en:
The moment
Junior took up
the mic, the
cheers made the
ground shake.

entries.jp: 人々の熱狂は高まり　魂を\nジュニアに奪われたように\n陶然としている
entries.en:
The people's
frenzy rose; they
stood entranced,
as though Junior
had stolen their
souls.

entries.jp: その圧倒的な魂の音に\n高杉たちも聴き惚れかけた
entries.en:
Even Takasugi
and the others
nearly fell under
the spell of that
overwhelming
sound of the soul.

entries.jp: 何をぼんやりしている！\n貴様らがここで負けたら\n日本はどうなる！
entries.en:
Snap out of it!
If you lose here,
what happens
to Japan!?

entries.jp: そうだよ！\nそれに僕の貞操も\nピンチなんだけど
entries.en: That's right! Plus,\nmy virtue's in\ndanger here, too.

entries.jp: そうじゃった！
entries.en: Oh, right!

entries.jp: 沖田の貞操は知らねえが\nあいつに日本を好き勝手\nさせるわけにはいかねえ
entries.en:
I don't give a
damn about
Okita's virtue,
but I can't let
that guy do
whatever he
wants with Japan.

entries.jp: 藁で巻かれるなんて\nごめんですよ
entries.en: And I'd rather not\nbe wrapped in\nstraw, thank you.

entries.jp: そ　そうじゃった\nそんなんじゃ\n風邪を引くぜよ！
entries.en: R-right! That'd\nmake ya catch\na cold!

entries.jp: トサカくんはバカだから\n引かなそうだけど
entries.en:
Idiots don't catch
colds, though, so
I doubt
Tosaka-kun
would.

entries.jp: 何故か夏には引くんじゃ
entries.en: For some reason\nI only ever catch\n'em in summer.

entries.jp: ……それってやっぱり\nバカなんじゃ
entries.en: ...And only idiots\ncatch summer\ncolds, so yeah.

entries.jp: 龍馬がバカなのは\n今さらだろう！\nそれより！
entries.en: Ryoma being an\nidiot is old news!\nNever mind that!

entries.jp: ああ　俺達も力を貸す\n今度は五人で行くぞ
entries.en:
Yeah. We'll lend
you our
strength. This
time, the five of
us go together.

entries.jp: やっぱり僕がいないと\nダメなんだから
entries.en: See? You\nreally can't do\nit without me.

entries.jp: くやしいですが\n今は言い返せませんね\nお願いします
entries.en:
It's frustrating,
but I can't argue
right now.
Please, help us.

entries.jp: よっしゃあ！\nわしら超魂團の\nロックをぶつけるぜよ！
entries.en:
All riiight! Let's
hit 'em with
the rock of our
Ultra Soul!

entries.jp: よし　行くぞ\n龍馬っ！
entries.en: All right, let's\ngo, Ryoma!

entries.jp: 龍馬のギターソロを最初に\n五人の超魂が輝き始める
entries.en:
Starting with
Ryoma's guitar
solo, the Ultra
Souls of the five
began to shine.

entries.jp: じゅにあーっっ！\nわしらのロックも\n聴くぜよ！
entries.en: Juniooor! Listen\nto our rock too!

entries.jp: ん？\nまだいたのか……
entries.en: Hm? You're\nstill here...?

entries.jp: 勝ちに来たぜ！
entries.en: We came\nhere to win!

entries.jp: 確かにお前のロックは\nすごい
entries.en: Sure, your\nrock's amazin'.

entries.jp: 熱い魂を\n熱情を感じる！
entries.en: I can feel a\nred-hot soul!\nReal passion!

entries.jp: だが　わしらだって\nロックを愛する心では\n負けていないぜよ！
entries.en:
But when it
comes to hearts
that love rock, we
ain't losin' either!

entries.jp: ああ\nその通りだ！
entries.en: Yeah! Damn right!

entries.jp: まだ勝負は\nついていません
entries.en: The match\nisn't over yet.

entries.jp: 今度は俺達もいる
entries.en: This time,\nwe're here too.

entries.jp: 全力でいっちゃうよ！
entries.en: We're going\nall out!

entries.jp: ほう……！\n超魂か
entries.en: Oh...! An Ultra\nSoul, huh.

entries.jp: ドンウォリ\nＪ
entries.en: Don't worry, J.

entries.jp: それでも　連中は\nオレの引き立て役に\n過ぎん
entries.en: Even so, they're\nnothing but a foil\nto make me shine.

entries.jp: 何故なら――
entries.en: Because--

entries.jp: オレがロック\nオレこそがロック
entries.en: I am rock. I\nalone am rock.

entries.jp: 前座の出番はそこまでだ\n次はオレの曲を\n聴かせてやる
entries.en:
Your time as the
opening act is
over. Next, you'll
hear my song.

entries.jp: イッツ\nロケンロゥーッ！
entries.en: It's rock 'n' rolllll!

entries.jp: 眩しく輝く\n龍馬達の超魂
entries.en:
The dazzling
Ultra Souls of
Ryoma and
the others
shone bright.

entries.jp: だがペリージュニアの持つ\n超魂の力はそれ以上だった
entries.en:
But the power of
the Ultra Soul
Perry Junior held
was even greater.

entries.jp:
小さな星を呑み込む
太陽の如く
巨大に熱く燃えさかり
龍馬たちに襲い掛かる！
entries.en:
Like a sun
swallowing tiny
stars, it blazed
vast and hot, and
fell upon Ryoma
and the others!

entries.jp: ぐあっっ！\nな　なんじゃ　これは？\n体が熱い……！
entries.en:
Gwaah! Wh-what
the heck is this!?
My body's
burnin' up...!

entries.jp: 魂が燃やし尽くされそうだ\nまさか　こんな……
entries.en:
It feels like my
soul's being
burned to ashes.
I can't believe...
something like
this...

entries.jp: 私達の超魂が\n押さえつけられるっ……
entries.en: Our Ultra\nSouls are being\nheld down...!

entries.jp: ヤツは\nどれほどの力を……
entries.en: Just how much\npower does he\nhave...?

entries.jp: ちょっと\nこんなの反則でしょ
entries.en: Hey, come on.\nThis is totally\ncheating.

entries.jp: じゅにあ\nお前も超魂を……
entries.en: Junior... You've\ngot an Ultra\nSoul too...?

entries.jp: 当然だ\n世界中のロッカーが\nオレの前にひれ伏した
entries.en:
Of course.
Rockers all over
the world have
bowed down
before me.

entries.jp: ワン　ツー　スリー……\n大体　オッケー
entries.en: One, two, three...\nPretty much okay.

entries.jp: 複数の超魂だとっ
entries.en: Multiple\nUltra Souls!?

entries.jp: そんなことが\nあり得るなんて……
entries.en: How could such\na thing even be\npossible...?

entries.jp: でも　実際ヤツの体から\nいくつもの超魂を\n感じるよ
entries.en:
But I really do
feel several Ultra
Souls coming
from his body.

entries.jp: ちゃんとした\n条約が欲しいなら
entries.en: If you want a\nproper treaty...

entries.jp: ユー達の超魂と\n引き換えにしようか
entries.en: ...how about you\ntrade me your\nUltra Souls for it?

entries.jp: 悪くない取り引きだろう\nドゥー　ユー\nアンダースタン？
entries.en: Not a bad deal,\nright? Do you\nunderstand?

entries.jp: わからん！
entries.en: Don't understand!

entries.jp: ふざけるな！
entries.en: Quit messin'\naround!

entries.jp: それは呑めません
entries.en: We can't\naccept that

entries.jp: わからん！　\nわしにはじゅにあの言う事は\nさっぱりわからんぜよ！
entries.en:
Don't understand!
I can't make
heads or tails of
what you're
sayin', Junior!

entries.jp: ユーはバカなのか？
entries.en: Are you an idiot?

entries.jp: バカでも　わしらの超魂を\n渡すわけにはいかん！\nそれだけはわかる！
entries.en:
Idiot or not, we
ain't handin'
over our Ultra
Souls! That much
I understand!

entries.jp: この超魂はわしらの\nロック魂じゃ！\n誰にも渡さんぜよ！
entries.en:
These Ultra Souls
are our rock
souls! I ain't givin'
'em to nobody!

entries.jp: よく言ったぜ　龍馬！\nオレ様の魂はオレ様の\nものだ！
entries.en:
Well said, Ryoma!
Yours truly's soul
belongs to yours
truly!

entries.jp: ええ　私達の大切な\n宝です！
entries.en: Yes. They're\nour precious\ntreasures!

entries.jp: ふざけるな！\nこの超魂は松陰先生の\n大事な形見だ！
entries.en:
Quit screwing
around! This
Ultra Soul is
Shoin-sensei's
precious
keepsake!

entries.jp: そうじゃ！　\nわしらの魂はわしらのもの\n誰にも渡さんぜよ！
entries.en:
That's right! Our
souls are ours! I
ain't givin' 'em to
nobody!

entries.jp: ええ　なんと言われようと\n手放す気はありません！
entries.en:
Yes. Whatever
you say, I have
no intention of
letting it go!

entries.jp: オレ様達の魂を\nよこせなんてふざけたこと\n二度と言えなくしてやる！
entries.en:
"Hand over
your souls"? I'll
make sure you
never say crap
like that again!

entries.jp: それは呑めませんね\nこの超魂は私達のロックを\n愛する心そのものです
entries.en:
I'm afraid we
can't accept that.
This Ultra Soul
is our very love
of rock itself.

entries.jp: ああ　絶対に渡さねえ
entries.en:
Yeah. No way
in hell we're
handing
them over.

entries.jp: わしらの魂をよこせなんて\nとんでもない話ぜよ
entries.en: Hand over our\nsouls? That's just\nplain outrageous!

entries.jp: 私達全員お断りします
entries.en: All of us decline.

entries.jp: 俺だって渡せるものか……\nこの超魂は俺の全てだ！
entries.en:
As if I'd hand
mine over... This
Ultra Soul is
everything I am!

entries.jp: 暑苦しいのはゴメンだけど\n僕にだって譲れないもの\nくらいあるんだ
entries.en:
I hate all this
hot-blooded
stuff, but even
I have things I
won't give up.

entries.jp:
ジュニアの持つ超魂の
圧倒的な力に
押しつぶされそうに
なりながらも
五人は立ち上がる
entries.en:
Though the
overwhelming
power of
Junior's Ultra
Soul threatened
to crush them,
the five rose to
their feet.

entries.jp: だが　ジュニアは\nそんな五人を涼しげに\n見下ろすだけだった
entries.en: But Junior only\nlooked down\ncoolly on the five.

entries.jp: ん～\n大体　オッケー\nわかったわかった
entries.en: Mmm~ Pretty\nmuch okay. I\nget it, I get it.

entries.jp: ま　ユー達の超魂も\n絶対に欲しいわけじゃ\nない
entries.en: Well, it's not like\nI absolutely need\nyour Ultra Souls.

entries.jp: な　なんじゃと
entries.en: Wh-what'd\nyou say?

entries.jp: ニッポン中で雷舞をする\nそうすればみんな\nオレのトリコだ
entries.en:
I'll do lives all
over Nippon.
Then everyone
will be under
my spell.

entries.jp: それなら　ニッポンも\nイッツマイン\nオール　オレのもの
entries.en:
And then
Nippon's mine,
too. It's mine.
All of it, mine.

entries.jp: そ　そんなこと\nさせてたまるもんか！
entries.en: L-like I'd ever\nlet you do that!

entries.jp: テメェ……どこまでも\n好き勝手いいやがって！
entries.en:
You bastard...
saying
whatever the
hell you please!

entries.jp: 本当に\n傲慢ですね……
entries.en: You really are\narrogant...

entries.jp: しかたない\nオレはロック\nアイムロック
entries.en: Can't help it. I\nam rock. I'm rock.

entries.jp: ロックとはオレ\nオレとはロック
entries.en: Rock is me.\nI am rock.

entries.jp: オレの歌だけ\n聴いていればいい\nオレこそが神だ
entries.en: All you need is to\nlisten to my songs\nalone. I am a god.

entries.jp: わしはロックが好きじゃ\nお前のロックにも\n熱い魂を感じる
entries.en:
I love rock. And
I can feel a
red-hot soul in
your rock too.

entries.jp: だが　お前のロックは\n天歌と同じぜよ！
entries.en: But your rock's\njust the same as\nHeaven's Song!

entries.jp: ……ヘブンズソング？\nＪ？
entries.en: ...Heaven's\nSong? J?

entries.jp: わしは絶対に\nお前に勝つ！
entries.en: I'm gonna\nbeat you, no\nmatter what!

entries.jp: モンキーはモンキーの\n歌を歌ってろ
entries.en: Monkeys should\nstick to singing\nmonkey songs.

entries.jp: イッツ\nロケンロゥーッ！
entries.en: It's rock 'n' rolllll!

entries.jp: 熱狂する民衆の中\nジュニアは\n高々とギターを掲げた
entries.en:
Amid the
frenzied crowd,
Junior raised
his guitar high.

entries.jp: 王者は不敵に笑い\nステージに君臨する
entries.en:
The king smiled
fearlessly and
reigned over
the stage.

entries.jp: 壮麗なギターリフが\n五人の魂を打ちのめした
entries.en:
A magnificent
guitar riff
struck down the
souls of the five.

entries.jp: くそっ……\n体が動かねえ
entries.en: Dammit... My\nbody won't move.

entries.jp: 指が石になったようです
entries.en: It's as if my\nfingers have\nturned to stone.

entries.jp: くっ……
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.jp: ありえない……！
entries.en: This can't be...!

entries.jp: なんて力ぜよ……\nじゃが　わしらは\n絶対に負けん！
entries.en:
What power...
But we ain't
gonna lose, no
matter what!

entries.jp: くうううぅぅう\n盛り上がってきたぜよ！
entries.en: Nnnngh! Now\nthings are\ngettin' good!

entries.jp: 今　ここに再び\n熱い声技の戦いが\n幕を切った……！
entries.en:
Here and now,
a fierce battle
of voices began
once more...!
